records.title: NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning
records.reason: NeuronEye improves visual concept grounding/accuracy in a VLM forward pass; the abstract does not claim reduced inference compute, latency, or memory.

records.title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples
records.reason: RICE improves dense retrieval representations from in-context examples; it does not present an inference-efficiency or serving-cost contribution.

records.title: Pruning for Efficiency, Paying in Fairness: Demographic Disparities in Pruned Speech-LLMs
records.reason: This is a fairness evaluation of pruning rather than a new inference-efficiency technique, and the disparity effect varies by dataset/language. Its relevance is secondary to the survey’s mechanism focus.

records.title: Self-Aligned Forcing: Streaming Video Diffusion with Differentiable Noisy History
records.reason: Self-Aligned Forcing targets streaming video diffusion generation and reports inference throughput for video generation, not language-model inference/serving.

records.title: VideoLoop: Looped Working Memory Against Semantic Thrashing in Long-Form Video Agents
records.reason: The paper does not report token/latency/throughput savings from the bounded memory, and its scope is long-video agent orchestration rather than a general LLM inference or serving optimization.
